summary: Implemented Phase 1 diagonal anisotropic medium support with explicit `AnisotropicMedium` public models, deferred-policy surfaces for `FullyAnisotropicMedium` and direct `Medium2D` simulation use, per-axis coefficient compilation, anisotropic constitutive-update helpers, typed IR lowering, examples, README updates, and focused validation coverage.
key_findings: `AnisotropicMedium` is now the implemented tensor-material path: it accepts per-axis scalar medium families, lowers to typed IR, compiles into `AnisotropicMaterialCoefficients`, and supports mixed standard, dispersive, and clamp-mode branches across `xx/yy/zz`.

`Medium2D` remains deferred for direct simulation, but Phase 1 now exposes explicit conversion helpers to volumetric `AnisotropicMedium` or `PoleResidue` so later sheet-material workflows have a defined lowering path instead of an implicit gap.
`FullyAnisotropicMedium` is now a parseable, validated public surface with an explicit deferred runtime policy, so users get clear serialization and error behavior instead of silent fallback.
Kernel support now includes per-axis anisotropic electric and magnetic updates plus anisotropic auxiliary-state allocation, reusing the existing pole-residue path where a diagonal axis is dispersive.
Verification passed with `PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q` and `PYTHONPATH=src python -m compileall src`.

artifacts.description: New anisotropic material models and explicit defer-policy surfaces for `FullyAnisotropicMedium` and `Medium2D`.
Per-axis anisotropic coefficient preparation and explicit runtime-policy errors for deferred medium families.
Diagonal anisotropic constitutive-update helpers and anisotropic auxiliary-state allocation.
Coverage for anisotropic models, conversion policy, coefficient compilation, IR lowering, runtime rejection behavior, and anisotropic kernel updates.
Recorded the anisotropic-material decisions and handoff notes for later subpixel work.

follow_up_notes: Direct `Medium2D` simulation support and full dense-tensor `FullyAnisotropicMedium` runtime support remain intentionally deferred. The new diagonal anisotropic path is now available for later subpixel materialization work.
